en.text:
Grants 8% increased damage to Combatant Shields.

Breaking a Combatant Shield with a <primary/>Primary or <heavy/>Heavy weapon grants 6% <special/>Special Ammo Meter progress. 

Breaking a Combatant Shield with a <special/>Special weapon grants 6% <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Meter progress.

Ammo Meter Progress increases to #e 8% when enhanced.
